name: Kuwait
regionName: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: none; the government does not recognize any political parties or allow their formation, although no formal law bans political parties

profile.religions: Muslim (official) 74.6%, Christian 18.2%, other and unspecified 7.2% (2013 est.)
profile.legalSystem: mixed system consisting of English common law, French civil law, and Islamic sharia law
profile.suffrage: 21 years of age and at least 20-year citizenship
profile.location: Middle East, bordering the Persian Gulf, between Iraq and Saudi Arabia
